Sofia Park: Support flagged a customer who migrated and their vector index started failing. Short repro: quickstart embed call without model pin returned 128d instead of 1536d.
Ethan Moore: That's the alias fallthrough. We're not explicit about that in the v1->v2 migration guide.
Lena Novak: Action items: update quickstart snippets to pin embed model; add a "pitfall" note in migration guide; add a docs smoke test that asserts embed length.
Sofia Park: Proposed snippet change: `await client.embed({ model: 'h2o-embed-1536', input: 'hello' })` and equivalent py example.
Ethan Moore: I'll open a small PR for the snippet swap (JS/TS/Py).
Lena Novak: I'll draft the migration caveat paragraph and banner copy: "If you relied on model aliases, confirm the embedding model and vector dimensionality after migration; pin model IDs in production."
docs-bot: Created issue "docs: embed alias silent fallback - migration note" (#5077)
Ethan Moore: CI smoke test plan: run sample embed in staging and assert len(vec) == expected_dim, but only enforce when docs-owner label present to avoid noisy failures.
ci-bot: Smoke job queued: docs-embed-dim-check run id 2026-10-02_14:22
Sofia Park: ETA for PRs: snippets by Thu, docs draft by Wed, CI WIP by Wed. Will coordinate merges.
ci-bot: Smoke job completed: PASS (vector dim 1536) run id 2026-10-02_14:25
Lena Novak: Merged docs + snippets and added changelog and support blurb. I'll notify support templates.
Sofia Park: Thanks team, closing loop.
